# Temporal Measurement

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TemporalMeasurement>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A measured assignment of a date or age to an entity or sample, carrying the method, uncertainty, and determinacy. Now a subclass of [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md) (and therefore [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)), realising [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9): the measurement is a standpoint-indexed claim (vantage + [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) + [`observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md)), not ground truth.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a date or age is a measured, method-bearing, uncertain claim by some vantage — a radiocarbon date, a dendro count, an ICS boundary age — rather than a self-evident timestamp.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a simply-stated crisp date (use a [`gmeow:Instant`](gmeow-Instant.md) with [`gmeow:instantValue`](../properties/gmeow-instantValue.md)) and for non-temporal measurements; this is a [gufo:Relator](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator) reifying a dating claim, not the date value itself.

### How to use

- Mediate a [`gmeow:vantage`](../properties/gmeow-vantage.md) (the dating agent/lab) and a [`gmeow:observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) (the dated thing), then attach [`gmeow:measuredAge`](../properties/gmeow-measuredAge.md) or [`gmeow:measuredDate`](../properties/gmeow-measuredDate.md), [`gmeow:hasUnit`](../properties/gmeow-hasUnit.md), [`gmeow:measurementUncertainty`](../properties/gmeow-measurementUncertainty.md), [`gmeow:measurementMethod`](../properties/gmeow-measurementMethod.md), and [`gmeow:measurementDeterminacy`](../properties/gmeow-measurementDeterminacy.md); competing measurements coexist as standpoint-indexed claims (P9).

### Examples

- ex:charcoalDate a [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md); [`gmeow:vantage`](../properties/gmeow-vantage.md) ex:labXYZ; [`gmeow:observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) ex:hearthSample; [`gmeow:measuredAge`](../properties/gmeow-measuredAge.md) "4200"^^[xsd:decimal](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal); [`gmeow:hasUnit`](../properties/gmeow-hasUnit.md) <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/YR>.
